<description>
**Problem:** While reviewing #35847, we found that test helpers attaching active-tip block templates to arbitrary parents could retain the wrong work target or subsidy. Rebuilding the coinbase input script for heights 1 through 16 without padding also produces a script below the minimum length. Existing callers avoid these cases or handle them locally, so no current test fails.

**Fix:** Share the parent-dependent reconstruction between `BuildChain()` and `MinerTestingSetup::Block()`. Use the caller-selected timestamp, recalculate the work target and subsidy for the actual parent and height, and append a dummy `OP_0` to the coinbase input script. Require coinbase-only templates so replacing the reward cannot discard transaction fees.
</description>
